flashcards.a: A CRM is the system of record for contacts, companies, deals and activities.

flashcards.q: When is summary applied in AI CRM Integration?
flashcards.a: When AI works outside the CRM, its insights are lost; when it works inside, every summary and next step becomes part of the account history.

flashcards.q: Where does summary come up in AI CRM Integration?
flashcards.a: An AI assistant reads the account and deal history, produces a summary or recommendation, and writes the result back to a field or activity.

flashcards.q: Who is involved with stays clean in AI CRM Integration?
flashcards.a: AI CRM Integration teaches how to connect AI to a customer relationship management system so data stays clean, insights appear where people work and actions are recorded automatically.

flashcards.q: What does AI CRM Integration teach about records?
flashcards.a: The integration should only access records the user is allowed to see.

flashcards.q: When is drafting applied in AI CRM Integration?
flashcards.a: Webhooks let the CRM notify another system when something happens, such as a deal changing stage, which can trigger an AI action like drafting a handoff note.

flashcards.q: Where does field mapping come up in AI CRM Integration?
flashcards.a: Field mapping defines where each AI output lands.

flashcards.q: Who is involved with records in AI CRM Integration?
flashcards.a: The integration should only access records the user is allowed to see.

flashcards.q: When is summary applied in AI CRM Integration?
flashcards.a: A call summary may go to the activity notes, next steps to a task, and competitor mentions to a dedicated field that can be reported on.

flashcards.q: Where does every come up in AI CRM Integration?
flashcards.a: Every new field needs a report or decision that uses it.

flashcards.q: When is suggestions applied in AI CRM Integration?
flashcards.a: Move to automatic writes only for low-risk fields after the suggestions prove accurate.

flashcards.q: Where does person accepts come up in AI CRM Integration?
flashcards.a: Audit twenty open deals for missing or stale fields, design the field mapping for AI call summaries in your CRM, and run a two-week read-only pilot where AI suggests updates and a person accepts or rejects each one.

flashcards.q: When is stale close applied in AI CRM Integration?
flashcards.a: Define a hygiene routine: duplicate detection, missing next steps, stale close dates and stage mismatches, reviewed weekly with AI-generated fix lists.

flashcards.q: When is forecast applied in AI CRM Integration?
flashcards.a: Forecast accuracy improves when AI compares stage, activity and engagement signals against historical outcomes, rather than relying only on representative judgment.
